blocks.en: Many problems arising naturally in differential equations call for a generalized definition of functions, derivatives, convergence, integrals, etc. In this subsection, we discuss a number of such questions, which will be adequately answered below.
blocks.zh: 微分方程中自然出现的许多问题要求对函数, 导数, 收敛, 积分等作广义定义. 本小节讨论若干这类问题, 下文将对它们给出恰当的回答.
